title: FLUFFY CHASE
duplicate_check: No matching host in prior-urls.json, catalog-baseline.json published_games, or previously_seen_urls; confirmed in the prior dedupe pass.
controls_actions: Started Solo mode; title instructions say WASD/arrows to move and turn, Space for yarn/special, Shift or double-tap direction to dash, E to inspect or enter/exit a cab, and J to jump.
Held W for 1.6 seconds, turned with A, then held W for 1.8 seconds and D for 1.2 seconds; the player character and camera position changed visibly, and the gameplay timer advanced.
Expanded the city map during play. HUD continued to show Case 01, Walk up to the first taxi, and Make the yellow taxi fluffy; the taxi objective was not completed.
gameplay_outcome: Direct gameplay started and actual movement in response to keyboard input was observed. The player moved from the initial street position toward a sidewalk/building edge; the objective remained incomplete during this short test.
mechanics: Third-person 3D city chase with a yarn/special action and interactable yellow taxi; the objective asks the player to approach the first taxi and make it fluffy. The title instructions also describe dash, jump, inspection, and taxi entry/exit controls.
visual_art: Custom 3D New York street environment with brick storefronts, traffic lights, road markings, a third-person avatar with colorful hair/headwear, HUD objective markers, and a minimap. The build uses Japanese UI labels in several controls and map labels.
existing_custom_cover_evidence: Custom title screen and game-specific 3D gameplay are present; no separate promotional cover asset was verified.
thumbnail_concepts: Text-free, close low-angle action shot of the colorful-haired avatar beside the bright yellow taxi on a New York street, with yarn sparks and the taxi as a clear focal point.
The avatar dashing toward the yellow cab while the city minimap and a dramatic street corner frame the chase; use the taxi's yellow against dark brick and asphalt for contrast.
screenshot_note: Gameplay screenshot was captured and shown inline in the CUA output; this subagent CUA surface exposes no supported local screenshot-file export.
audio: Parent verified the macOS output-mute checkbox is enabled; no native audio settings were changed by this tester. This test tab was closed after the session.
